query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scraper_logs (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  platform ENUM('instagram', 'soundcloud') NOT NULL,
  action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
  targetUsername VARCHAR(255),
  status ENUM('success', 'error', 'banned', 'rate_limited') NOT NULL,
  error TEXT,
  timestamp DATETIME NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_platform_timestamp (platform, timestamp),
  INDEX idx_status (status)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scraper_accounts (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  platform ENUM('instagram', 'soundcloud') NOT NULL,
  username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  password VARCHAR(255),
  status ENUM('active', 'banned', 'suspended', 'rate_limited') DEFAULT 'active',
  lastUsedAt DATETIME,
  banDetectedAt DATETIME,
  totalActions INT DEFAULT 0,
  successfulActions INT DEFAULT 0,
  failedActions INT DEFAULT 0,
  createdAt DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_platform_username (platform, username),
  INDEX idx_status (status)
);
